name: insolvia-e2e
//: End-to-end tests that run against DEPLOYED staging, after the deploy and
NOT AN NPM WORKSPACE MEMBER, deliberately — the root package.json's
`workspaces` array is explicit and this directory is absent from it, for
exactly the reason apps/insolvia_marketing is absent: Node resolution walks
UP the tree, so a dependency this package forgot to declare would resolve
from the repo-root node_modules and pass CI, then fail in a clean install.
Its own package-lock.json and its own `npm ci` in the E2E job are what
catch that. Do not add it to the root `workspaces` array, and do not run
the root `npm ci` and expect these deps to be there.
NOT A REQUIRED PR CHECK, deliberately — see CLAUDE.md in this directory.
NO CREDENTIALS LIVE HERE. The repo is public. The test user's email and
password come from E2E_TEST_USER_EMAIL / E2E_TEST_USER_PASSWORD in the
environment, with no defaults and no fixture file.
